reason: In app/assets/javascripts/admin/templates/group.hbs:21, the keyword form {{each member in members itemView="group-member"}} sets options.hash.keyword = "member" (vendor/assets/javascripts/development/ember.js:8404-8412), which causes collectionHelper (vendor/assets/javascripts/development/ember.js:7997-7998) to bind the itemView's _context to _parentView.context (AdminGroupController, an Em.ObjectController proxying the Discourse.Group) while putting the Discourse.User in _keywords.member (vendor/assets/javascripts/development/ember.js:8222-8224). Therefore {{#unless automatic}} in app/assets/javascripts/admin/templates/group_member.hbs:1 resolves automatic against the group controller, not the member.
